name: DrawPassFeature
signature: public sealed class DrawPassFeature(PassType type, RenderSlot slot, int order = 0) : RenderFeature

docs.summary: Draws the visible renderables' pass of one type, the shader pass tagged "LightMode" = type, onto the scene in a slot, such as "Outline" after the opaques. Each pass draws with its own render state, so outlines, silhouettes seen through walls and similar effects need only the pass in their shaders.
